title: 第13章 传承者的据点第14章 旧时代的真相
lines: 翻过最后一道山梁，身后那片荒凉的山野突然安静了下来。
一直跟着我们的风声、草动，还有石子滚落的细碎声响，好像被一道看不见的墙给挡住了，一下子全没了。整个山谷陷入一种说不出的寂静，没有活物的气息，也没有那种混乱的能量在流动。
这儿静得有点吓人。
废土上到处弥漫的暴躁辐射、混乱的地脉气流，在这里全都消失了。整片山谷被一种厚重而温柔的宁静包裹着，安稳得过分，和外面那个破败危险的世界完全像是两个地方。
这种安宁太纯粹、太干净了，根本不像是在这乱世废土中能出现的景象。
陆寻脚步顿了顿，眼神依旧沉稳，没放松警惕。他的手一直紧紧牵着林小满，把她护在身边，手指轻轻收拢，默默传递着安心。旁边的苏野同时举枪戒备，枪口朝下，目光锐利地盯着山谷深处，牢牢守住队伍的退路，全身紧绷，防备十足。
三人不用说话，默契自然形成，迈着谨慎的步子，慢慢向山谷深处走去。
越往里面走，周围的地脉波动就越平稳有序，不像外面那样狂暴混乱，反而透出一种严谨的规律感。
在林小满的精神感知中，原本散乱的地脉气息，渐渐织成了一张完整、有序、层层相连的大网。这股力量温和却庞大，不伤人也不躁动，像一片沉静的海，稳稳托住了整个区域，把外面所有的轮回乱象和辐射乱流全都挡在了外面。
“这是人工建的地脉屏障。”林小满轻声说道，语气里带着震撼，“有人提前梳理了整个山谷的地脉，用旧时代的规则阵法把这里锁住了，硬生生在废土轮回中保住了一片净土。”
百年灾变，万物倾覆。
连黑石镇地下的锚点都只能默默沉睡，可这片隐秘的山谷，却被人主动维护着，常年养护，躲过了一次次轮回清扫。这样的底蕴和手段，绝不是普通幸存者能有的。
前面的林木幽深，古树错落生长，枝干苍劲，绿意盎然。
这在废土荒山里极其罕见。外面的草木多半枯黄扭曲、变异畸形，只有这里的植物鲜活舒展、生机纯净，没有半点辐射侵蚀的痕迹，干净得仿佛不属于这个破败的世界。
走到山谷最深处，一面平整巨大的山壁突然挡住了去路。
山壁浑然一体，岩石纹理整齐均匀，没有天然山石的粗糙感，明显是经过精细的人工打磨。表面没有任何符文、没有机关按钮，朴素得找不到破绽，却牢牢封死了所有前进的路，透着一股恒久不变的沉静。
“入口就在这儿。”陆寻目光定在山壁上，沉声说道。
他能清楚地感觉到，山壁不是实心的，表面只是伪装，后面藏着巨大的空洞。整面山壁就是据点的隐藏入口，依靠地脉的力量藏了百年，完美骗过了世上所有的探查和轮回清扫。
林小满微微凝神，用精神感知轻轻触碰山壁表面。
下一刻，沉寂百年的岩层微微震动。
没有巨响，没有炫目的机关启动景象，只有一阵低沉、古老的机械运转声，从地底深处缓缓传来。厚重的山壁沿着预设的轨道，平稳地向内凹陷、横向滑开，一点点露出漆黑的通道。
尘封百年的气息，迎面扑来。
不同于废土那种腐朽荒芜的味道，这里的空气干净清澈、微凉湿润，没有辐射尘埃，没有血腥暴戾，只有岁月沉淀下的厚重与安宁，是旧时代文明残存下来的纯粹气息。
通道笔直向下，台阶宽阔整齐，两边嵌着早已停止运作的微光灯带。虽然早已不能照明，但结构完整、毫无锈蚀，依然能看出旧时代工艺的精巧与坚固。
三人对视一眼，不用多说，稳步走进通道。
一路向下，深入地下几十米，外面的天光彻底被隔绝，周围陷入一片柔和的昏暗。但这种黑暗并不压抑，反而透着一种极致的安稳宁静，和地面上危机四伏的废土，完全是两个世界。
踏下最后一级台阶，视野豁然开朗。
一座庞大恢弘的地下基地，静静展现在眼前。
content_en:
After climbing over the last ridge, the desolate mountain wilderness behind us suddenly became quiet.
The sounds of wind, grass, and pebbles that had been following us all seemed to be blocked by an invisible wall, and all of a sudden disappeared. The entire valley fell into an indescribable silence, with no breath of living creatures and no chaotic energy flowing.
It's eerily quiet here.
The violent radiation and chaotic earth energy flow that permeated the wasteland all disappeared here. The entire valley was wrapped in a thick and gentle tranquility. It was too stable and seemed completely different from the dilapidated and dangerous world outside.
This kind of peace is too pure and clean, and it is not like a scene that can appear in this troubled wasteland.
Lu Xun paused, his eyes still calm, and he did not let down his guard. His hand had been holding Lin Xiaoman tightly, protecting her by his side, and he gently closed his fingers, silently conveying reassurance. Next to him, Su Ye raised his gun on guard at the same time, with the muzzle pointing downwards, staring sharply into the depths of the valley, firmly guarding the team's retreat, his whole body tense and fully on guard.
The three of them didn't need to speak, and a tacit understanding formed naturally. They walked cautiously towards the depths of the valley.
The further you go inside, the more stable and orderly the surrounding earth veins fluctuate. It is not as violent and chaotic as outside, but reveals a strict sense of regularity.
In Lin Xiaoman's mental perception, the originally scattered aura of the earth's veins gradually woven into a complete, orderly, and layer-by-layer network. This force is gentle but huge, neither hurtful nor restless. Like a calm sea, it firmly supports the entire area and blocks out all the reincarnation chaos and radiation turbulence outside.
"This is an artificial earth barrier." Lin Xiaoman said softly, with shock in his tone, "Someone sorted out the entire valley's earth veins in advance, locked it here with the regular formations of the old era, and forcibly preserved a piece of pure land in the wasteland reincarnation."
A hundred years of cataclysm, everything overturned.
Even the anchor point underground in Blackstone Town can only sleep silently, but this hidden valley is actively maintained and maintained all year round, avoiding repeated cleaning cycles. This kind of background and means are definitely not available to ordinary survivors.
The forest in front is deep and dark, with ancient trees growing here and there, with vigorous branches and lush greenery.
This is extremely rare in the wasteland and barren mountains. Most of the vegetation outside is withered, twisted, mutated and deformed. Only the plants here are fresh and stretched, with pure vitality. There is no trace of radiation erosion, and they are so clean that they seem not to belong to this dilapidated world.
When we reached the deepest part of the valley, a huge flat mountain wall suddenly blocked the way.
The mountain wall is integrated and the rock texture is neat and even, without the roughness of natural rocks. It is obviously finely polished manually. There are no runes or buttons on the surface. It is so simple that no flaw can be found, but it firmly blocks all the way forward, exuding an everlasting tranquility.
"The entrance is right here." Lu Xun fixed his gaze on the mountain wall and said in a deep voice.
He could clearly feel that the mountain wall was not solid, the surface was just a disguise, and there was a huge cavity hidden behind it. The entire mountain wall is the hidden entrance to the stronghold. It has been hidden for hundreds of years by relying on the power of the earth's veins, and has perfectly deceived all exploration and reincarnation cleaning in the world.
Lin Xiaoman concentrated slightly and gently touched the surface of the mountain wall with his spiritual perception.
The next moment, the rock formations that had been silent for hundreds of years shook slightly.
There was no loud noise, no dazzling sight of the machine starting up, only a low, ancient sound of mechanical operation slowly coming from deep underground. The thick mountain wall smoothly sunk inward and slid sideways along the preset track, revealing the dark passage bit by bit.
The breath that has been covered in dust for a hundred years rushes towards him.
Different from the decayed and desolate smell of the wasteland, the air here is clean, clear, slightly cool and moist. There is no radiation dust, no bloody violence, only the heaviness and tranquility accumulated by the years, which is the pure atmosphere remaining from the civilization of the old era.
The passage goes straight down, with wide and neat steps, and dim light strips that have long since stopped working are embedded on both sides. Although it is no longer illuminated, the structure is intact and free of rust, and the exquisiteness and sturdiness of the old-era craftsmanship can still be seen.
The three of them looked at each other and walked steadily into the passage without saying anything.
All the way down, tens of meters deep underground, the outside light was completely cut off, and the surrounding area fell into soft darkness. But this darkness is not depressing. Instead, it exudes an ultimate sense of stability and tranquility. It is a completely different world from the crisis-ridden wasteland on the ground.
Stepping down the last step, the view suddenly opened up.
A huge and magnificent underground base is quietly displayed in front of you.
title_en: Chapter 13 The Stronghold of the Inheritor Chapter 14 The Truth of the Old Era
